publication.title: Visual Schemas and Queries for Knowledge Graph Exploration

source_reading.scope: Complete main report and footnotes: schema diagrams, query generation/execution, property selection, text/visual transition and future work.

adjudication.basis: ViziQuer implements class/link/schema-fragment queries directly from schema diagrams, customizes displayed properties, and allows schema-backed textual edits and transfer into the richer visual query environment. Its user-benefit and evaluation claims remain expectations rather than measured outcomes.
